name: desktop_gpu12
_note: ILLUSTRATIVE PROFILE. Every rate, latency and energy figure below is a modelling assumption chosen to be plausible for the named class of hardware; none is a measurement. Replace with measured values before drawing hardware conclusions.

devices.name: host
devices._comment: 16-core desktop CPU, 2x DDR5-5600 (89.6 GB/s theoretical x 0.6 sustained = 54 GB/s), 400 GMAC/s INT4. The arithmetic rate is the sustained rate of llama.cpp's quantised matrix-matrix kernels (prompt processing); token generation stays limited by memory bandwidth at this rate, as llama.cpp on desktop CPUs is commonly reported to be. Energy per operation is set so that full arithmetic load draws roughly the package power. v0.2 used 80 GMAC/s, which made prompt processing several times too slow. An assumption until calibrated.

devices.name: gpu
devices._comment: 12 GB discrete GPU; kernels are memory-bound; 3 us launch overhead per kernel; experts issued back-to-back share one launch (0.2 us each after the first)
